text:
Divine eyes, light of my soul,

for the first time I saw you angered;

and sooner would I have seen the heavens collapse,

or the cold earth open before my feet!


Have, ah, compassion on the agony

in which my senses lie buried,

when I see you sparkling and indignant

look at me, burning with impious fierceness.


Ah, forgive me if I wronged you; perhaps

I feared losing you, and with my plea and tears

instead of binding you, I only offended you more;


Have, have pity on my ruin,

for if you turn and strike me fierce again,

you will sink me into the realms of terror.

translation.title: Divine Eyes
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the formal appeal to the beloved's eyes and the speaker's melodramatic terror.
